  - Brief diarrheal episode around symptom onset, resolved.

Management Plan

- Summary of key actions and recommendations given:
  - Likely viral respiratory infection; supportive care recommended.
  - Advise purchase/use of a thermometer and measure temperature (patient instructed to check temperature).
  - Continue symptomatic treatment (patient using lemon-sip/Lemsip); do not take additional paracetamol-containing products concurrently with Lemsip.
  - Avoid daytime use of cough suppressants; small dose at night acceptable if cough prevents sleep.
  - Monitor closely due to diabetes: contact clinician/seek review if any of the following occur — persistent fever >37.5–38°C or ongoing high temperatures, worsening cough, development of purulent sputum, hemoptysis, epistaxis, new/worsening shortness of breath or chest pain.
  - If symptoms suggest bacterial infection or do not settle, antibiotic therapy may be considered on reassessment.
  - Ensure routine diabetes and blood pressure follow-up with primary care as requested by GP.

  - No follow-up appointment scheduled in transcript; patient told to re-contact if worsening or persistent symptoms.
